carriers.priceBasis: Quoted by Delta Cargo on request (1-800-352-2746); no published tariff.
carriers.crate: IATA Live Animals Regulations crate; pet must stand, sit upright, lie down and turn around without touching top or sides.
carriers.restrictions: Delta Cargo pet shipping is temporarily restricted to active U.S. military and State Department Foreign Service officers with permanent change of station orders. Brachycephalic breeds restricted. No shipping above 80F or below 20F; certificate of acclimation required between 20F and 45F. No sedatives. USDA-accredited vet health certificate within 10 days.
carriers.leadTime: Book at least 14 days before departure; tender 4-6 h early (domestic), 6 h (international) at the cargo facility.
carriers.note: A general passenger cannot fly a 20 kg dog on Delta, domestic or to Europe: too big for cabin and cargo closed to the public. Delta does not offer checked pets.

carriers.priceBasis: Quoted on request by IAG Cargo through an approved pet travel agent; depends on crate size, pet+crate weight, origin/destination, airport handling and import fees.
carriers.crate: IATA LAR crate; flat-faced breeds (e.g. Boxer, Boston Terrier) need a crate about 10% larger than normal (secondhand).
carriers.restrictions: No pets in cabin or as checked baggage; all animals except recognised ADI/IGDF assistance dogs travel as manifest cargo. Bulldogs of any type, Pugs and Pekingese not carried (secondhand).
carriers.note: Airline and IAG Cargo pages not readable (iagcargo.com returned 403). Secondhand typical range: Fetchapet (pet shipper) publishes GBP 2,600-8,000 for a dog with BA, door-to-door agent service; secondhand, not an airline tariff.

carriers.priceBasis: Booked only through a pet agent at IAG Cargo; quoted on request.
carriers.restrictions: Pets not accepted at passenger check-in. Domestic cats and dogs only. Not on flights over 9 hours flying time (secondhand).
carriers.note: Aer Lingus page blocked by bot check. Search snippets (third-party pet-policy sites) cite an older airline fee of EUR 160 per sector per crate (or EUR 40 short-haul to EUR 160 long-haul), and a traveller report of about EUR 1,500 each way via IAG Cargo including handling; both secondhand and not current tariffs. North American pet desk: petdesk@iagcargo.com, 1-866-300-4004.

carriers.priceBasis: Per pet one-way: CA/US $105.00-$126.00 within Canada and Canada-U.S. (range reflects taxes by origin); CA/US $270.00-$324.00 international.
carriers.crate: Hard-sided, non-collapsible, no wire crates; secure, leak-proof, firm-closing door with locking pins; pet must stand, turn and lie down. Pet + kennel up to 45 kg (100 lb); max 292 cm linear. Strong dog breeds need reinforced metal/mesh containers.
carriers.restrictions: Brachycephalic breeds prohibited. Summer: not carried above 29.5C (85F) to many destinations, year-round to some tropical ones. No pets 18 Dec - 4 Jan. Certain aircraft excluded.
carriers.leadTime: Register the pet with Air Canada Reservations within 24 h of booking the flight.

carriers.priceBasis: Per pet one-way, domestic vs international, low vs high season.
carriers.crate: Pet + crate up to 45 kg; heavier pets go via Aeromexico Cargo. Official crate dimensions not readable.
carriers.restrictions: Pets at least 8 weeks old. Flights to Paris and Amsterdam need a request at least 72 h ahead (secondhand). Breed and temperature rules not read.
carriers.leadTime: 72 h for Paris/Amsterdam (secondhand); otherwise not found.
carriers.note: aeromexico.com pages returned a maintenance error or JS shell. Third-party figures conflict: volapata.com (citing the Mexican site) domestic 1,800 MXN low / 2,195 MXN high, international 5,570 / 5,840 MXN; other snippets say domestic 1,600-1,950 MXN and international 5,050-5,200 MXN or USD 252-258; an older snippet 1,520/1,910 MXN and USD 182/189. All secondhand; price left null pending the airline's own page.

carriers.restrictions: PetSafe suspended for the general public since 2018 and not reinstated as of 2026; only active-duty military on PCS orders and State Department staff.
carriers.note: United page timed out; status from search snippets (citizenshipper.com, petholidayclub.com).

carriers.restrictions: Checked pets only for active-duty U.S. military and State Department Foreign Service officers; general passengers cannot check a pet. In-cabin fee USD 150 (not applicable to a 20 kg dog).
carriers.note: aa.com returned 403; from search snippets. American Airlines Cargo pet price not found.

carriers.priceBasis: Per pet one-way: CAD 100-118 within Canada and to/from the U.S. (range reflects taxes); CAD 200-236 elsewhere.
carriers.crate: Hard-sided kennel, max 101 x 68 x 81 cm, up to 45 kg per kennel (pet + kennel). 1-3 kennels per flight by aircraft.
carriers.restrictions: Brachycephalic dogs and strong/aggressive breeds must go via WestJet Cargo. Pets at least 8 weeks. No pets to Barbados, Hawaii, Ireland, Jamaica or the UK.
carriers.leadTime: Pre-book by phone at least 48 h before departure.
carriers.note: Rules verified on westjet.com/en-ca/pets; the fee figures come from a search snippet of westjet.com, not read on the page itself.

carriers.priceBasis: Domestic flight, per pet one-way (secondhand); international fee not found.
carriers.crate: Rigid, clean, waterproof, ventilated, no wheels, escape-proof with handles; length = body length + 1/4, width = 2x widest part, height max 90 cm; pet + container max 45 kg (100 lb). ID labels required.
carriers.restrictions: Dogs and cats only; max 7 pets in the hold (secondhand). Pit bulls, bulldogs, boxers and other breeds Volaris classes as dangerous or aggressive not carried as checked baggage.
carriers.note: Weight and crate rules verified on the Volaris page; the 1,400 MXN domestic fee is from a search snippet (older press article), not read on Volaris's page.
